current.text: The Lakers have open starting spots in the frontcourt. The newest projected starting five is Doncic, Reaves, Grimes, Thybulle and Kessler, and LaRavia could start instead. Grimes, Mamukelashvili and Ziaire Williams are also in the mix.
His starting role is not settled. Experts see him as a possible starter, but the newest preview has him coming off the bench.
He should play 20-plus minutes even without a starting job. One expert expects the Lakers' sixth man to play about 27 minutes.
ESPN's rank of about 120 is too high. He is a deeper-league or streaming player, and more interesting if he wins a starting spot.
He is worth a last-pick flyer as a possible starter. Experts would move off him if he does not start.
The Lakers play 3-4-3 games in our playoff weeks with a March 28 end, which is in the bottom half of the league.
The Lakers have the second most back-to-backs in the league.

durable.text: He has an odd fantasy game. His shooting percentages swing a lot, and his 3P% moved from 42 to 32 between seasons.
He is a category-only player. His value comes from steals, few turnovers and some assists, not from scoring.

note: LaRavia is a 0 to 1 USD player (Yahoo rank 164, ESPN rank 123). With 144 players drafted, he is a last-pick flyer at best and was not drafted in our league last season. His value is steals (1.3 per game) and few turnovers, while points, threes and assists are below the pool, so he only fits builds that chase STL and TO. Check the Lakers' opening-night starting lineup. Keep him if he starts. If he comes off the bench, cut him or leave him on waivers, also because the Lakers have a weak 3-4-3 playoff schedule.
